tools.name: replay_span
tools.description: Fork-replay ONE recorded span from a failed agent run and return an attribution verdict (determinism vs tool drift vs env drift vs world-state vs model decision), without re-running the whole run.

tools.name: fork_safety_check
tools.description: Examine ONE recorded span (or a run's span set) forensically — canonicalization, env binding, completeness, stub coverage — and return the fork-safety verdict (FORK-SAFE-LIVE / FORK-SAFE-STUBBED / FORK-DEGRADED / FORK-UNSAFE) WITHOUT executing the span or forking anything. $0.01 per span checked on
